goal: Replace OptimizedPDFViewer with a SquidCloud-styled Folio PDF engine, tone down motion/gloss, and fix the preview dock on wide screens.
goal_source: interactive query from human (not from backlog)
last_actions: 2026-11-23: Researched Folio on GitHub (owenpkent/folio, MIT, React + pdfjs-dist + zustand + Tauri). It is a full desktop app, not an npm library, so the portable part is its page engine.

Added src/components/FolioPdfViewer.tsx: Folio's architecture (pre-measured page layout boxes, IntersectionObserver-gated canvas rendering with DPR cap, separate PDF.js text layer, page dimensions cache, fit width/page/custom, rotation, page tracking from scroll, lazy thumbnails) with SquidCloud chrome: floating grouped top/bottom docks, neutral glass, CSS eased transitions only.
Switched EnhancedInstantPreviewModal to FolioPdfViewer for PDFs (kept OptimizedPDFViewer for DeepReadReader).
Fixed wide-screen dock: anchored with plain CSS corner values plus !important and data-edge variant instead of animated inline right/bottom; removed the m motion value entirely.
Calmed motion: modal/player springs now stiffness ~300 damping ~28-34, rubber stretch 96->44, press scales softened, removed velocity overshoot and the glossy conic rim on the preview dock.
blockers: No local tsc; Vercel cloud build authoritative (build passed).
Folio's full editor feature set (annotations, signatures, OCR, Tauri integrations) was intentionally not ported - only its page engine and viewer behaviours.
next: Await visual verification of PDF page rendering/text layer, dock visibility on wide screens, and calmer motion.
